messages.message:
JUST IN: "Big Short" investor Michael Burry warns a stock market crash is coming.

"The stock market is quite obviously in its first stage of grief, denial. Per 2000 and 2008, this stage lasts 6-9 months."

Burry has repeatedly said the stock market is going to crash this year. Today, the S&P 500 hit a new all-time high.
